messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Incomplete archive?
parts:
Hi Scott,

I think there's some misunderstanding.

If you've followed the instructions and have installed the C++ toolchain that we suggested (RTools), then you're ready to go from Stan programs to machine executable code.

You'll need to supply a Stan program to make it work, though. That's why I tried to point you to the example-models repo. Stan is a language, so you can write whatever model you're interested in. It's not like other toolkits where you build it and toss data at it.

If you have specific questions about how to get started or if you're still confused, please let us know where in the directions you're lost.


Daniel
